logline: Alexander frees Juliana from her chains and proclaims her the Duchess of Ashburton before the stunned congregation, only for an ecclesiastical authority to burst in and declare their marriage legally invalid.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 44's climax where Alexander walked away from Catherine towards Juliana standing in chains at the church doorway.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full tracking shot following behind Alexander as he walks down the rubble-covered stone aisle toward Juliana.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander strides purposefully down the cathedral aisle, ignoring the watching nobles as Juliana stands shackled in her rustic grey dress near the entrance.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, tears welling in her eyes.

segments.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander stops in front of Juliana and sinks onto one knee before her.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, looking up at her with profound devotion.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Look at me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low angle close-up of Juliana looking down into Alexander's eyes with rising disbelief.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander's hands as he unfastens the heavy iron lock and releases the chains from Juliana's bruised wrists.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she stares intently into his eyes.

segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Overcome)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Your eyes...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.

segments.label: JULIANA (Emotional, Realizing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It's you.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Solemn, Loving)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: It was always me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.

segments.label: JULIANA (Shocked, Wondering)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You're the Duke?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Firm, Resonant)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.

segments.label: JULIANA (Incredulous, Moved)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: All this time?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Tender, Deep)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You chose me when you believed I was nobody.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sincere, Loving)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I chose you because you were kind.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Passionate)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You chose me when I had nothing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.

segments.label: JULIANA (Resolute, Warm)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I chose you because you had honor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Earnest, Devoted)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: And I chose you because you saw the man before the title.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Heartfelt)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I loved you before I ever knew who you were.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Soft, Vowing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Pleading, Desperate)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Alexander...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Cold)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Gasping, Lying)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I didn't know!

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Biting)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You knew exactly what you were doing!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Booming, Condemning)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Trembling, Stunned)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Wife?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Resounding)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Before the Crown and before God...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander stops in the center of the nave and raises Juliana's hand high above their heads.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Proclaiming, Powerful)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Rupert and Mary standing in the pews, their eyes wide with horrified disbelief.

segments.label: RUPERT (Gasping, Shellshocked)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: Juliana?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing proudly together, exchanging a loving gaze amid the awestruck crowd.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Stern)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: No one will bow yet!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Official)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Harsh, Resolute)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Unyielding, Condemning)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow push-in close-up on Catherine beneath her veil, her initial despair morphing into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as the episode cuts.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine raises her chin, a vindictive smirk spreading across her lips as she realizes her rival's claim has just been torn to pieces.
